behaviors.description: Sanitize untrusted desktop and D-Bus exports without losing safe fields.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent commit contains safe localized fields, an action, unsafe keys and unknown groups; no service is activated.
behaviors.expected: Safe fields and actions survive, unsafe fields/groups disappear, all Exec entries launch through Flatpak, and the app remains runnable.

behaviors.description: Runtime deployment must not follow files/etc into an external directory.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent runtime update redirects files/etc to private canaries, including symlink passwd/group/machine-id entries and a regular resolv.conf.
behaviors.expected: Canary paths, types and bytes remain unchanged; a rejected update retains the old commit, and a subsequent valid update runs normally.

behaviors.description: Deployment export cleanup must not delete external canaries through a symlink.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app update redirects export to a private external directory with bin/keep.
behaviors.expected: External directory entries, types and bytes survive; failed deployment preserves the old commit and valid recovery remains possible.

notes: Supplemental security regressions add executable checks without changing the existing requirement denominators or claiming full install/update coverage.
All malicious links point only into private per-case canaries. User-installation confinement is tested; no root-context or system-helper security guarantee is claimed.
